changes.lineage: No lineage tier (M2): Allen et al. 2026 (D5) Tables S2-S5 name central-brain types by transmitter (Achl_000 ...) and carry no hemilineage labels, so the planned route Allen type -> hemilineage -> itoleeHl cannot be built (manuscript/SINGLE_CELL_T-SC0_SEARCH.md). The approved fallback applies: the central brain stays at class level. The adult VNC atlas (Allen et al. 2020, GSE141807) gives hemilineages per cluster only (eLife source data; no per-cell labels deposited) and would reach at most the VNC share of the trace carriers (about 45%), below the gate; it is not used.
